mentions.name: Abejora
mentions.description: Timesheet software for freelancers and small teams, positioned as an affordable alternative to timesheet SaaS companies whose prices have risen sharply. Pricing does not scale with user count and features are functionally complete with no arbitrary plan tiers. Built with Elixir and Phoenix LiveView and deployed on a Talos Kubernetes cluster. Recent work focuses on the temporal nature of timesheet data — handling historical versions, retiring, locking, changing, and reopening records or rates — to keep everything accessible and user friendly.
mentions.problem: Timesheet SaaS companies have engaged in price gouging, charging far more as team size grows and using arbitrary tiers to force users into more expensive plans.
mentions.audience: Freelancers and small teams seeking affordable, functionally complete timesheet software without arbitrary pricing tiers
